responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(Hash)] expansion for the Rust front end. This file synthesizes a core::hash::Hash impl with a generic hash<H: Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H) method, generating per-field Hash::hash calls for structs and tuple structs, and for enums first hashing core::intrinsics::discriminant_value(&self) and then matching variants to destructure and hash their payload fields; unions are rejected with an expansion diagnostic.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for Hash derivation: it contains the executable logic that constructs hash<H: Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H), emits per-field Hash::hash calls, and handles enum discriminant/match hashing, whereas rust-derive-hash.h only declares the DeriveHash API and helper signatures.
